title: S1 V3.9 / S2 V3.2 — Macro factor attribution, composite redundancy, and GVZ as a continuum
strategy: S1 AweWithBB V3.9; S2 Hammer V3.2
question: After the Macro composite was revoked from the 請分析 score for lacking power, does any individual Macro factor separate S1 or S2 outcomes; how much of the composite is one input counted twice; and does GVZ have any breakpoint at all, rather than the assumed 13/20?
hypothesis: Expected negative. The composite's failure was a sample-size failure, and splitting the same trades by single factors cannot add power. GVZ was the one plausible exception because its rule claimed a mechanism (S2 mean reversion degrading in high volatility) rather than a correlation.

findings.title: No single Macro factor separates outcomes
findings.detail: No individual Macro factor separates outcomes in either strategy. Every observed gap (S1 1.08-5.85pp, S2 0.54-6.43pp) is far below what its own sample can resolve (S1 ~13.3-15.2pp, S2 ~23.2-26.4pp), and no noise test comes near significance.

findings.title: The composite is half one input
findings.detail: The composite is half one input. US10Y and Real Rate agree 89.2% of the time in the S1 window and Real Rate is US10Y minus T10YIE by construction, so 3 of 6 points move together. It behaves closer to a four-factor score with one input at half weight.

findings.title: The composite separates less than first reported
findings.detail: The replicated composite separates less than the original study reported: a 1.49pp verdict spread against 14.9pp resolvable (noise p=0.973), versus 3.98pp before. The difference is the stricter previous-day assignment used here.

findings.title: S2 and GVZ is the only near-miss
findings.detail: S2 and GVZ is the only near-miss and the only result worth carrying forward. Below GVZ 22 S2 wins 59.72% (n=72, PF 3.421); above it 34.33% (n=67, PF 1.2), a 25.39pp gap that does exceed the 23.2pp resolution limit. It does NOT survive correction for having searched 15 thresholds: shuffling outcomes reproduces a best gap this large 10.7% of the time.

findings.title: The rule threshold of 20 is not where any S1 signal is
findings.detail: The current rule threshold of 20 is not where any S1 signal is. At 20 the S1 gap is 1.94pp; what little gradient S1 shows sits at the low end, below 15-17, in the opposite direction to the rule that was removed.

findings.title: DXY points the opposite way to the panel, in both strategies
findings.detail: DXY is the only factor pointing the same way in both strategies, and it points against the panel: the state the panel calls gold-bullish (dollar below its average) has the LOWER win rate in both (S1 55.88% vs 61.73%, S2 44.29% vs 50.72%). Not significant; recorded because a consistent wrong-way sign is more interesting than a random one.

card_summary: Macro factors and GVZ thresholds, tested one at a time; nothing separates outcomes.
summary_zh: Macro 各因子與 GVZ 門檻逐一測試，沒有任何一個能區分結果。S2 與 GVZ 的接近顯著在多重比較校正後 p=0.107。
